arg.name: fcu_url
arg.description: MAVLink FCU connection URL (serial device, tcp://, or udp://)

arg.name: gcs_url
arg.description: Optional MAVLink GCS bridge URL (empty = no bridge)

arg.name: tgt_system
arg.description: MAVLink target system id (1 + ROS_DOMAIN_ID in sim)

arg.name: respawn_mavros
arg.description: Respawn the MAVROS node if it dies

arg.name: namespace
arg.description: Extra namespace for the MAVROS node. EMPTY by design: since mavros 2.15 the mavros_node hosts its plugins under a UAS sub-node literally named 'mavros', so it already supplies that level. Setting this to 'mavros' (as we did for mavros 2.12, where plugins published into the node namespace) doubles it: /ROBOT/interface/mavros/mavros/state instead of /ROBOT/interface/mavros/state, which every consumer in the stack -- and airstack ready -- subscribes to. Matches the upstream node.launch default.
